description: Explain why a card payment was declined or failed. Accepts a decline code, response code, refusal reason or error message (for example "51", "05", "do_not_honor" or "insufficient funds") from card networks and processors such as Visa, Mastercard, Stripe and Adyen. Optionally narrow by provider.

code.description: A decline code or message, for example "51", "05", "do_not_honor" or "insufficient funds".

provider.description: Optional provider or card network to narrow the result, for example "Visa", "Mastercard" or "Stripe".

name: lookup_decline_code
title: Decline code lookup
